scripts.install:all: npm ci && npm --prefix backend ci && npm --prefix frontend ci
scripts.test: npm run backend:test && npm run frontend:test
scripts.frontend:build: node -e "const { spawnSync } = require('node:child_process'); const env = { ...process.env, VITE_API_URL: process.env.VITE_API_URL || 'http://localhost:3001', VITE_RUNTIME_MODE: process.env.VITE_RUNTIME_MODE || 'live' }; const result = spawnSync('npm', ['--prefix', 'frontend', 'run', 'build'], { stdio: 'inherit', shell: true, env }); process.exit(result.status ?? 1);"
scripts.verify: npm run backend:test && npm run frontend:lint && npm run frontend:typecheck && npm run frontend:test && npm run frontend:build
